_citation: Approach = MBON-11 (gamma1pedc>alpha/beta, GABA), 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18 (cholinergic) and avoidance = MBON-01..07 (all glutamatergic): Aso et al. 2014 eLife 3:e04580 (activation screen; 'all MBONs eliciting aversion were glutamatergic and all the MBONs eliciting attraction were either GABAergic or cholinergic'); NT per type from Aso et al. 2014 eLife 3:e04577 Table 1. MBON17 (alpha'3m) was tested jointly with MBON16 (alpha'3ap) in that screen. MBON19 and MBON23 are NOT in these lists: MBON19's NT is N.D. in Aso 2014 and MBON23 is a later hemibrain type (Li et al. 2020). MBON21, MBON29 (cholinergic, aversive) and MBON33 (attractive) per Rubin & Aso 2024 eLife 90523 (activation results read from partial text; verify). '-like' annotations are left unassigned (no valence evidence). PAM = reward, PPL1 = punishment: Aso et al. 2014 eLife 3:e04577 compartment map; Li et al. 2020 ('PPL1 DANs generally convey punishment, PAM DANs generally convey reward'). Learning = depression of opposite-valence KC->MBON synapses: Hige et al. 2015 Neuron, Owald et al. 2015 Neuron.
